<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<cutscene xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="cutscenes.xsd">

  <director key="credits_movie" comment="Developer credits" />

  <environments>
    <environment_implicit name="scenezone" zone="tzoneCluster_black2_Sector01_Zone_macro" />
    <object_group name="testgroup">
      <reference object="playership" />
    </object_group>
  </environments>

  <presentation>
    <actions>

      <sequence name="DynamicSequence" start="0">

        <shot name="PlayerShip1" environment="scenezone" duration="auto">
          <video name="videos/credits"/>
          <camera_follow reference="playership" orient_to="object" interpolation="smooth"/>
        </shot>

      </sequence>
    </actions>
  </presentation>

</cutscene>
